{{Top|canon=Candorian Scourge}}
{{Quote|The plague, an airborne virus, is extremely contagious to Humans, and death is speedy, certain, and painful.|[[Imperial HoloVision]]|<ref name="GNN5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
The '''Candorian plague''' was a very contagious and deadly disease caused by the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]]. It was known to have triggered epidemics that decimated entire planets.

==Description==
[[File:Blue_shadow_virus_vial.png|thumb|right|150px|A sample of Blue Shadow Virus.]]
{{Quote|Allow me to present the return of the ''infamous'' Blue Shadow Virus.''"<br />"''The Blue Shadow Virus?! I thought that deadly disease was extinct.|[[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|audio=BlueShadowVirus-BSV.flac|<ref name="BSV">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>}}
The Candorian plague was caused by an airborne virus,<ref name="GNN5" /> known as the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]].<ref name="TEA-">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It was extremely contagious to [[Human/Legends|Humans]], leading to a speedy, agonizing, certain [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="GNN5" />

==History==
===Republic Dark Age===
{{Quote|The final hundred years of the Draggulch period are sometimes called the Republic's "dark age." The Republic could no longer afford to maintain its communications network. At the same time, an outbreak of the Candorian plague killed off as much as two-thirds of the citizens of some major population centers.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Draggulch Period]], the Candorian plague depopulated [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Rimward]] colonies of [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]].<ref name="TEA-" /> At the end of this period, during the [[Republic Dark Age]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] was moribund and an epidemic of the disease spread over the galaxy.<ref name="TEGtW-">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The plague wiped out as much as two-thirds of the population of some [[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="TNEC" /> The disease was particularly present in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] and it scourged the planet [[Sanrafsix/Legends|Sanrafsix]] and [[Alphoresis]].<ref name="TKEG">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref> By [[1060 BBY]], the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] was another casualty of the Candorian plague and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were all but decimated.<ref name="THoMA">{{SW|url=news/the-history-of-mandalorian-armor|text=The History of Mandalorian Armor|int=The History of Mandalorian Armor|nolive=1}}</ref>

===Recent history===
{{Quote|The last known strains are thought to have died out 46 years ago when the total loss of the Candorian colonies gave the virus no means of reproducing itself. There is no known antidote or cure.|Imperial HoloVision|<ref name="GNN5" />}}
In [[46 BBY/Legends|46 BBY]],<ref name="GNN5" /> the total loss of [[Candoria]]<ref name="TEA-" /> and the [[Candorian colonies]]<ref name="GNN5" /><ref name="TEA-" /> left the disease no way to propagate, and it was believed to be extinct.<ref name="GNN5" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] scientist [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] recovered a sample of the Blue Shadow Virus with the help of the mad [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]]<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> and tried to turn it into a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]].<ref name="TEA-" /> The plot was eventually [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|foiled]] by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].<ref name="BSV" />

However, the Candorian plague was later cultivated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for use against rebellious [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. It was used by the Empire against the planet [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], which had just [[Dentaal Uprising|expelled]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Taliff]] and declared independence. It killed hundreds of thousands in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Calif City]] within the first few hours of its appearance; within two days, it had killed ten billion people, sweeping over the entire [[Kindelian]] continent. The entire planet was depopulated within two months, and the Empire claimed that the plague was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] plot.<ref name="GNN5" /> The [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]], led at the time by [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], were the ones directly responsible for unleashing the plague on the planet under the Emperor's orders, which acted as the final straw leading to Madine's defection shortly thereafter, although he was still wracked with guilt for his involvement.<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Candorian plague was created in the [[1995]] magazine [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 5]] as the disease that was used by the Galactic Empire to decimate Dentaal,<ref name="GNN5" /> an event later mentioned in several books over the years.<ref name="TNEGtC" /> In [[2005]], the source book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' developed a story about a plague outbreak during the Republic Dark Age,<ref name="TNEC" /> an idea later used in the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Knight Errant'']] series of comics and novels.<ref name="TKEG" /> Finally, the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]]ed the Blue Shadow Virus from the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]] as the Candorian plague virus.<ref name="TEA-" /> This retcon was conserved after the [[2014]] [[canon]] reboot as the [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] sourcebook ''[[Unlimited Power]]'' clearly associated the Blue Shadow Virus and the [[Candorian Scourge]].<ref name="UP">''[[Unlimited Power]]''</ref>
